newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech February retail sales fall 0.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech February retail sales fall 0.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech February retail sales, in real terms, contracted 0.6 percent compared with the same month in 1996, putting sales 2.1 percent lower since the beginning of 1997, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Wednesday.

The CSU also said that total internal trade rose by 0.7 percent year-on-year in real terms in February. Internal trade from the beginning of the year to end-February, in real terms, was 0.8 percent lower year-on-year.
